summary: Capstone Companies filed an 8-K/A reporting an amendment to a non-binding Letter of Intent with eBliss Global, Inc. The amendment extends the no-shop period and the LOI expiration from July 31, 2026 to August 31, 2026 solely for continued due diligence. No definitive agreement, pricing, or transaction structure has been reached. This is a preliminary, non-binding arrangement with no material terms defined, making it akin to a non-binding LOI extension. The filing is an 8-K/A amending a prior Form 8-K.
